title: Green Revolution Timeline (Irrigated Agriculture)
subject: Geography
mermaidCode:
timeline
    title Green Revolution in PWU Region
    1960 : Introduction of HYVs of wheat & rice
    1965 : Indira Gandhi Canal operational
    1970 : Bhakra‑Nangal Dam completed
    1980 : Widespread use of NPK fertilizers & pesticides
    1990 : Peak productivity (>50% of India’s wheat output)
    2000 : Emerging groundwater depletion concerns
    2010 : Initiatives for sustainable irrigation (e.g., micro‑irrigation)
description: Chronological timeline highlighting key milestones of the Green Revolution in the Punjab‑Haryana‑Western UP belt and associated water sources and inputs.
